responses.body_preview: eCourts Home function onCaptchaSolved() { document.getElementById('captcha_form').submit(); } WebCivil Supreme WebCivil Supreme provides online access to information about cases in Civil Supreme Court in all 62 counties of New York State. You may search for cases by Index Number or the name of the Plaintiff or Defendant, look up cases by Attorney/Firm name, and view Calendars for each court. With our eTrack case tracking service you can receive email updates and appearance reminders for Civil Supreme Court cases. WebCivil Supreme is provided as a FREE public service by the New York State Unified Court System.
